name: Facet Stonetip
description: One hand rides mid-haft and the other near the butt, holding a ward that covers the body and keeps the head quick.

name: Glint Drive
description: A straight overhand chop drives the spike into the target along the line of the shoulder.

name: Toxin Pickhelve
description: The beak snaps down on a sword wrist and holds it for a breath, pulling the blade off its line.

name: Gust Ironthorn
description: Short paces keep the student's feet always set along the line the spike must travel.

name: Boring Pickfluke
description: The spike runs down the crease where breastplate meets skirt, driven by qi until it finds the opening.

name: Iron Puncture
description: The hammer face beats an arm down, then the wrist turns and the beak comes back through the opened guard.

name: Nova Crowbill
description: All of the body's weight and a hard burst of qi fall on the spike, which pierces the breastplate's steel.

name: Chime Crack
description: With the beak locked in a rim or strap, the student pivots on one foot and throws the target past him.

name: Thorn Peckhead
description: Qi spreads from the student's feet as a faint field and the pick stands steady within it.

name: Waistpoint Assault
description: A tap of the spike on armor sends a fine qi pulse into the metal to test where it will give.

name: Backbill Remedy
description: The student raps the haft on the ground and reads through the qi field who stands and moves nearby.

name: Gust Hardtooth
description: The haft trails along the ground while the student glides forward, the field holding balance steady.

name: Glint Backbill
description: Qi narrows to a needle at the very point of the spike, so a thin gap in plate is enough.

name: Unflinching Peckhead
description: The field closes around the haft in the instant of contact, and a heavy blow glances away from it.

name: Chimepick
description: A pulse of qi through the beak sets its catch hard in the armor, and the student pulls the wearer off balance.

name: Rupturing Drive
description: A burst of field qi runs down the spike on contact and strikes the body beneath the plate rather than the plate itself.

name: Hardtooth Fastness
description: The spike sinks into a plate and its qi holds there, anchoring the foe's armor to the pick as he struggles.

name: Ironfluke
description: Elbows tucked and the pick held upright against the chest, the student covers himself in a crush of men.

name: Harrowing Spikebeak
description: The pick is held tight against the ribs and the spike stabs out a short hand's length at the nearest gap.

name: Chime Peck
description: An elbow shove opens a gap and the beak hooks through it, dragging a foe's arm away from his body.

name: Gust Punch
description: The student edges sideways along the front rank, never turning his back on the men facing him.

name: Cracktorment
description: With the ranks locked, a short hammer blow carries a burst of qi that jars through two men.

name: Paralyzing Crowbill
description: The haft is pressed flat across a foe's chest and arms and holds him pinned against the men behind.

name: Toxin Chink
description: The beak wedges between two shield-bearers and a qi-heavy wrench forces the line open at that point.

name: Rumble Peck
description: Where a rank has just opened, the spike darts through the gap with a rush of qi and strikes the man behind.

name: Hoarfrost Pickfluke
description: The pick waits low with the beak forward, covering the legs and ready to hook before it drives.

name: Glint Stonetip
description: A short punching thrust of both hands sends the beak straight into the nearest gap.

name: Chink Cuirass
description: The beak hooks a wrist and a turn of the haft twists the hand open, so the weapon falls.

name: Puncture Barrage
description: After the beak withdraws, the hammer face taps the same spot on the return line.

name: Crowelixir
description: One look at how a foe's armor is laced shows which strap the beak should seize first.

name: Spikebeak Cuirass
description: A qi-hard haul pulls the foe forward onto the hammer face, which is already swinging to meet him.

name: Harpooning Ironthorn
description: The haft rolls in the fingers and the pick head turns over, so the hammer face lands where the beak just pulled.

name: Chime Hardtooth
description: With the beak caught in an enemy's belt, the haft braces against his thrust and shoves the blade wide.

name: Staggering Waistpoint
description: The beak bites an armor edge and a mighty qi-backed haul bends the plate away from the body.

name: Scalding Pickhelve
description: At the instant the beak lets go of the bent plate, the head rises and the spike falls through the opening.

name: Granite Pickfluke
description: The pick is held with hammer and beak both facing the foe, so either face can meet him.

name: Tempered Crack
description: Two quick thrusts of the spike land in the same place, the first loosening and the second piercing.

name: Mayhem Punch
description: The beak catches the rim of a helmet bowl and draws the head down toward the student's knee.

name: Silt Peck
description: The student's feet curve around the foe in a bend, flowing past his guard to the open side.

name: Harpooning Punch
description: Hammer and beak travel on two tracks, one high and one low, so a single guard cannot stop both.

name: Murk Crowbill
description: The pick rises on an azure-bright arc of qi and its flat face turns a falling blade away.

name: Crowtorment
description: Hammer and beak fall as a pair, the hammer cracking the plate and the beak entering the crack.

name: Rumblepunch
description: The beak sets in a seam and a flowing, river-smooth wrench tears the plate loose in one long pull.

name: Facet Pickhelve
description: The student settles into a still crouch with the pick raised like a hawk's head, watching for the stoop.

name: Punchtorment
description: The beak drops fast from above and taps the target's plate once, marking the place for the real stoop.

name: Veritycrow
description: A long, patient look across a foe's armor picks out the single weak rivet or worn strap.

name: Might Chink
description: A light hop from the crouch lands the student a pace to the side, still coiled for the strike.

name: Facetcrow
description: The student drops onto the foe in a sudden stoop and the beak enters the plate like a striking claw.

name: Chimecrow
description: The haft folds in against the body like a wing and a sword cut slips off its qi-hardened wood.

name: Suppressing Drive
description: The beak clamps in a plate edge like a talon and holds the armored foe fast while qi flows through it.

name: Glint Ironthorn
description: From a high leap the student dives, the whole weight of body and pick behind the beak's single hard strike.

name: Quelling Waistpoint
description: The beak rips backward through the armor it has entered, tearing plate from lining and straps from buckles.

name: Unyielding Spikebeak
description: One hand holds a guard and the other a threat, the pick standing between on two tracks at once.

name: Glint Puncture
description: A low jab along the ground line sends the spike into a foe's leg as he steps onto uneven footing.

name: Silt Backbill
description: The student crosses broken ground in careful, testing steps, keeping the pick steady above the footing.

name: Remnant Pickhelve
description: A glance over the foe's shoulders and feet shows which way his weight is about to run.

name: Mayhempeck
description: The beak hooks and drags while the free hand drives the haft's butt in the opposite direction.

name: Enduring Waistpoint
description: The haft turns in a small tight circle like an eddy and spins an attacker's weapon past the student.

name: Blazedrive
description: The hammer strikes a rivet head while the beak presses the plate on its other track, shearing the rivet clean.

name: Glint Peckhead
description: Qi gathers in the raised pick like a river rising, then the spike plunges through armor in one broad rush.

name: Implacable Ironthorn
description: Feet spread wide as on open plateau stone, the student stands with the pick before him like a fixed post.

name: Flukeassault
description: The student fixes a bearing on one point of the foe's armor and thrusts the spike straight along it.

name: Paralyzing Pickfluke
description: With a sharp flick the beak snatches at a cloak or strap, letting the wind tug the foe's hold loose.

name: Crowbill Pounce
description: The student shuffles sideways across the line of the wind, so his pick stays upwind of the enemy.

name: Scorching Spikebeak
description: Standing at the plateau's edge, the student raps the hammer face on a foe who has his back to the drop.

name: Waningpick
description: A long look over the plain tells the student which way riders and cold wind are coming.

name: Toxinpunch
description: The student keeps his bearing on a foe, hooks the beak into his gear and drags him along the same line.

name: Enduring Stonetip
description: The haft meets a cut with the push of the wind behind it, and the blade is swept to the side.

name: Blaze Peck
description: With nothing to hinder the swing, the hammer face sweeps a wide flat arc through the foe's guard.

name: Mayhem Chink
description: The beak catches a foe at the plateau's lip and a heave with the wind behind it throws him over the edge.

name: Grinding Rumble Hardtooth
description: With the bearing held true from first step to last, the spike enters plate exactly where it was aimed.

name: Unbroken Backbill
description: The student plants himself with the pick upright, as one sworn not to give ground before the strike.

name: Blaze Crack
description: The hammer face raps down on a helmet crown in a heavy, deliberate beat.

name: Chime Drive
description: The beak checks a foe's advance by catching his shield edge and holding it to his bearing.

name: Mightfluke
description: Long, even paces eat the open ground and bring the pick to the foe without breaking stride.

name: Leaning Peckhead
description: The spike is leaned on with slow, qi-steady weight until it sinks through armor and will not be turned.

name: Chime Stonetip
description: A gust at the student's back adds force to the haft, which blocks a cut and drives it back.

name: Gustfluke
description: One slow, tremendous fall of the hammer face crushes a helm or pauldron beneath a full burst of qi.

name: Peckgreave
description: The beak hooks a foe and a sweeping pull, driven by wind and qi together, drags him off his feet.

name: Hoarfrost Stonetip
description: The student squares his chest to the wind with the pick braced before him and leans into the blow of it.

name: Glint Punch
description: A light prick of the beak marks a bearing on a foe's plate and draws his guard to that spot.

name: Waning Spikebeak
description: Leaning into the wind, the student reads from its shifts how the enemy ranks are moving.

name: Drivecanter
description: The feet barely touch the stone as the student skims toward the foe with the wind at his heels.

name: Novachink
description: Qi and wind together narrow the spike's point to a bare needle that slips through a plate joint.

name: Implacable Peckhead
description: The haft turns across the line of an incoming thrust like a vane catching a crosswind and sweeps it away.

name: Drivecuirass
description: The beak hooks a belt or harness and the student hauls with the wind's weight in his favor.

name: Rumblecrack
description: A gale of qi pushes the spike through plate on contact and out into the body behind.

name: Crack Hauberk
description: With the beak set deep in plate, the student pulls steadily along his bearing until the armor tears away.
